answer: Locks are written down in timber, expire in ivory, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 100 aliases as a result needs 67 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 857 identities would post 3896 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
